title: Analysis on the Influencing Factors and Innovation Path of EPC Project Transaction Model Based on Value Added
content: Although EPC mode has been widely applied in construction projects, few studies quantitatively explore its value‑added driving factors and systematic innovation framework.It is of great significance to innovate the traditional EPC project trading mode to realize the construction project goal and improve the project value. Based on the analysis of the logical structure of contract, contract type, owner management and project procurement in EPC project transaction mode, combined with questionnaire survey and structural equation model, the value increment of project is based on the value of project. Analysis of EPC project transaction mode, finally, the innovative design flow of EPC project transaction mode is formed, and the estimation of project progress and cost target increment is made.The results show that value‑added demand is the key driver, while path dependence on traditional modes hinders EPC innovation. This work provides decision‑making reference for optimizing EPC transaction schemes.It is expected that through the decision analysis of EPC project transaction mode and the optimization research of innovation design process, the value increment of the project will be achieved.
